title: APERTURE — Causal Loom: evidence register for meetings and project management
evidence_policy: Ten primary recent studies curated and linked; not automatically pulled from every discovery source. All commercial methods are hypotheses until locally evaluated.

studies.title: ReSUM: Reasoning-Driven Multi-Agent Framework for Query-Focused Summarization
studies.version: v1 — checked against primary arXiv page on 2026-11-10
studies.meeting_impact: Separate retrieval, evidence selection, and query-focused summaries; do not synthesize ungrounded commitments.
studies.caveat: Reported benchmark results do not validate APERTURE's implementation.

studies.title: GADR: Gathering Architecture Decision Records from Meeting Transcriptions
studies.version: v1 — checked against primary arXiv page on 2026-11-10
studies.meeting_impact: Treat decisions as evidence-linked drafts requiring an accountable person, source excerpt, and review.
studies.caveat: Feasibility study used a limited set of transcripts; decisions can be implicit and ambiguous.

studies.title: Retrieved-Span Training for Efficient Query-Focused Meeting Summarization on QMSum
studies.version: v1 — checked against primary arXiv page on 2026-11-10
studies.meeting_impact: Prefer source retrieval and concise context selection over full transcript dumping; flag unknowns.
studies.caveat: Automatic overlap scores are not a factuality guarantee.

studies.title: CoPE: A Framework for Optimizing Coordination between Planning and Execution in LLM-based Agents
studies.meeting_impact: Compare meeting plans with task execution, record deviations and repair affected branches.
studies.caveat: Benchmark improvements do not establish commercial productivity gains.

studies.title: TodoEvolve: Learning to Architect Agent Planning Systems
studies.meeting_impact: Adapt task planning structures to dependency complexity; do not force every project into one workflow.
studies.caveat: Research uses agent planning benchmarks, not APERTURE production projects.

studies.title: A large language model-based agent system for interactive large-scale project scheduling
studies.source: Journal of Computational Design and Engineering
studies.meeting_impact: Make schedule analysis responsive to dependency changes and allow analytical feedback instead of static Gantt plans.
studies.caveat: Industrial scheduling environment differs from small-business workflows.

studies.title: EAIR: Interaction Risks in Enterprise LLM Multi-Agent Systems
studies.version: v1 — checked against primary arXiv page on 2026-11-10
studies.meeting_impact: Enforce organization-level invariants when several teams change shared resources or deadlines.
studies.caveat: Risk detection design hypothesis, not audited protection against all failures.

studies.title: Responsibility Boundaries for Agentic Systems: A Comparative Evaluation of Probabilistic Agentic Programming
studies.version: v1 — checked against primary arXiv page on 2026-11-10
studies.meeting_impact: Explicitly separate suggested actions, meeting approval, and permission to execute side effects.
studies.caveat: Conditional proof assumptions and limited evaluation do not guarantee safety in other implementations.

studies.title: Benchmarking Forecasting Agents on Yesterday's Tomorrows
studies.version: v1 — checked against primary arXiv page on 2026-11-10
studies.meeting_impact: Evaluate predictions only against information known at decision time; keep forecasts separate from observed outcomes.
studies.caveat: Forecast benchmarks are not calibrated to local task estimates.

studies.title: Plan-and-Patch: Diffusion Language Models for Agentic Planning
studies.version: v1 — checked against primary arXiv page on 2026-11-10
studies.meeting_impact: Patch changed project dependencies selectively while preserving past decisions and approvals.
studies.caveat: Algorithmic results should not be misrepresented as a deployed feature.
